tspan.tspan: Decide the journal CSV column order, encoding and default
account codes (once, up front).
Where auto-run is enabled, every closing day up to today is
closed once a day between 6:00 and 7:00 JST.
Optional. Shows what a closing on a given date would bill,
without writing anything. Future dates are allowed.
Pick a date (today at the latest) and run. Running again for t
he same date never double-bills.
Per customer closing day (month-end if not set), collects S
hipped dispatch delivery orders from the day after the previ
ous closing up to this one and creates an Unprocessed clo
sing row. Stock storage is excluded.
Rows whose closing day has passed become a Draft invoi
ce at once and the closing row turns Processed. It is addre
ssed to the bill-to, and due date and tax are filled in autom
atically.
A row that could not become an invoice (e.g. no billable sh
ipments) stays Unprocessed in the list.
Open the closing row (or select several in the list) and gen
erate again.
Without waiting for the closing day, pick a customer's unbil
led shipments and create a Draft invoice. A Manual closing
row is kept as Processed.
Check the lines, the tax per rate and the due date. Amounts
come from the delivery orders and cannot be edited here.
Add charges from the charge master. Totals are recalculate
d and any approval is reset.
Pressing Issue raises an approval request. Approval only u
nlocks issuing (it does not issue). With no steps configured
it passes straight through.
Becomes Issued with the issue date recorded. The content
is fixed, the PDF becomes available and the invoice appea
rs in the partner portal.
Output the PDF (in the recipient's language) and send it by
email, fax or post. The app itself sends no email.
Becomes Sent with the sent time recorded.
Payment arrives by the due date.
Press after confirming the payment. With no payment-appro
val steps it becomes Paid immediately.
The final approval turns the invoice Paid.
Stays Sent. Recheck the payment and press Mark as paid a
gain.
Possible any time after issuing. The first export posts and f
reezes an accounting document; later exports return the sa
me CSV. The export time is recorded.
With the first posting, the source closing row moves from Pr
ocessed to Exported.
With a reason, cancel the posted accounting document wit
h a debit/credit-swapped one. The original is never rewritte
n.
After fixing account codes etc., exporting the CSV posts a n
ew accounting document.

svg.text: Billing — from billing closing to payment and accounting export
